task: Add per-user assistant sharing with grant/revoke endpoints, owner-only enforcement, visibility filter updates, and new Permission ResourceType for ASSISTANT

key_reasoning.reason: Four or more components touched across 3+ layers: AssistantBase.is_shared_with (model), ResourceType enum + Permission model (data), PermissionCreationService._check_principal USER branch + owner guard (service), AssistantRepository._filter_for_regular_user_visibility + _get_non_global_base_condition + _build_project_with_marketplace_query (repository), share/revoke + user-search router endpoints (API). Bumped from L to XL because the Permission infrastructure and Ability system are core shared utilities.

Closest pattern is DATASOURCE in the Permission table, but it does not cover three critical gaps: (1) PermissionCreationService._check_principal USER path is explicitly unimplemented (raises NotImplementedError); (2) AssistantRepository SQL visibility filter has no precedent for joining or subquerying the permissions table; (3) owner-only sharing constraint is stricter than the existing WRITE permission scope (which includes managers and admins), requiring a dedicated guard beyond Ability.can(WRITE). Auto-bumped for security-sensitive auth edge cases enumerated in ACs (AC#3 edit lock, AC#5 revoked-access denial, AC#7 non-owner rejection) with no existing test template. Further bumped for significant DB schema change (Alembic migration required). Net result: L → XL → XXL.

Four distinct layers: Data/Model (AssistantBase, Permission model, ResourceType enum), DB-Persistence (Alembic migration, SQL filter rewrite in AssistantRepository), Service (PermissionCreationService USER branch, owner guard), API (share/revoke endpoints, user-search endpoint). Bumped from L to XL because a significant schema change is included.

Estimated 8-12 modified files (assistant.py model, permission.py, assistant_repository.py x2 methods, permission_creation_service.py, assistant.py router, ability.py, user_project_repository.py) plus 3-5 new files (Alembic migration, new test modules for repository grant path, service USER path, owner enforcement, personal-project view). Spans 5+ directories.
